about.body: Welcome to [Club Name], UCSD's home for ambitious students passionate about business, innovation, and growth. From case competitions and startup pitches to networking events with industry leaders, we offer hands-on opportunities to sharpen your skills and build lasting connections. Join a community where curiosity meets ambition, and take the next step in your professional journey with us.
